symptom: describe of TestApp WorkflowCommons.Snip_Workflow_Header printed CaptionParams ({1} = System.Workflow_ParentWorkflow/Name) without its $Workflow root; exec wrote it with no source and mx check reported CE0402 'No value specified.' at actionButton1. textBox9 of Snip_WorkflowUserTaskView_Details (same shape on an input) was refused by check (MDL-WIDGET34). Also: {1} = $dv1.Name naming a non-enclosing data view was written as {Widget: dv1} (CE7001), and a page variable passed to a snippet parameter was written (CE0115)
cause: resolveAssociationAttributePath handled only context-relative paths; a $param-rooted path was 'unsupported', and isTemplateExpression treats $Var/... as an expression (mendixlabs/mxcli#1406), whose form for an association path is CE0117. describe printed the association path from AttributeRef without the SourceVariable root. Attribute: $P/Assoc/Attr parses as a DataSourceV3 (ContextVariable), not a string, so input builders never saw it
file: mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3.go (resolveRootedAssociationPath, resolveAssociationPathFrom), cmd_pages_template_attr.go (pb.isTemplateExpression), cmd_pages_parameter_binding.go (rootedAssociationPath, inputAttributeText), cmd_pages_describe_pluggable.go, cmd_pages_describe_parse.go, cmd_pages_input_binding_context.go
insight: Test through the classifier, not the resolver: the first resolver-level test passed while the builder still routed $Var/Assoc/Attr to Expression, and only the TestApp round trip (CE0117) showed it. The spelling $Root/Assoc/Attr was already claimed as an expression by #1406, so the binding wins only when the root resolves (a parameter or enclosing data view) and there is an association hop, mirroring the existing $currentObject/Assoc/Attr exception; everything else stays an expression. The proof was the round trip of Studio Pro's own snippet: 'Unchanged snippet' (byte-identical) and mx check 0 errors, against CE0402 before. The remaining CE1613 on text11/text16 in the same snippet is a separate gap (a specialization DestinationEntity dropped by describe), confirmed pre-existing with the old binary.
